economy.summary: Perry says inflation, the economy, and jobs concern most Americans; he opposes recent federal spending increases and supports reducing regulation and the national debt.
economy.short: Opposes federal spending increases; supports less regulation, debt reduction.

taxes.summary: Perry supports lowering taxes on families and small businesses and supports a Balanced Budget Amendment to the Constitution.
taxes.short: Supports lower family/small-business taxes and Balanced Budget Amendment.

abortion.summary: Perry states he believes in the sanctity of life, with exceptions for rape, incest, and danger to the life of the mother. He opposes late-term abortion and taxpayer funding of abortion.
abortion.short: Opposes abortion with rape, incest, life-of-mother exceptions; opposes taxpayer funding.

education.summary: Perry advocated for Pennsylvania to opt into the federal Education Freedom Tax Credit school choice program, appearing with the U.S. Education Secretary in Harrisburg and urging the governor to give families choice in how and where children are educated.
education.short: Advocates school choice; urges Pennsylvania join federal tax-credit program.

healthcare.summary: Perry opposes a government-run healthcare system and supports reforms including pre-existing condition coverage, reducing prescription drug costs, expanding health savings accounts, and allowing insurance purchases across state lines.
healthcare.short: Opposes government-run healthcare; supports HSAs, drug-cost reduction, cross-state purchase.

energy.summary: Perry supports a blended energy portfolio including Pennsylvania natural gas, hydroelectric, and nuclear power to achieve American energy independence, which he says can be balanced with protecting the environment.
energy.short: Supports natural gas, nuclear, hydroelectric; seeks American energy independence.

guns.summary: Perry describes himself as a staunch advocate of the Second Amendment and says he remains vigilant against any effort to limit those freedoms.
guns.short: Supports Second Amendment rights; opposes efforts to limit them.

economy.summary: Stelson says Central Pennsylvanians are working harder and falling further behind; she opposes tariff policies she says cost households over $2,300 and supports bipartisan efforts to lower costs of food, gas, housing, and prescription drugs.
economy.short: Opposes tariffs; supports lowering food, gas, housing, drug costs.

taxes.summary: Stelson supports tax breaks for the middle class rather than billionaires and opposes the budget she says slashes food assistance, raises utility bills, and adds $3.3 trillion in new debt.
taxes.short: Supports middle-class tax breaks; opposes budget adding $3.3 trillion debt.

abortion.summary: Stelson says women should make their own health care decisions with their doctors and pledges to fight to make the protections guaranteed under Roe the law of the land again. She opposes a nationwide abortion ban and restrictions on IVF.
abortion.short: Supports restoring Roe protections; opposes nationwide ban, IVF restrictions.

education.summary: Stelson calls schools the bedrock of communities and advocates ensuring teachers, education support professionals, meal servers, and bus drivers have the pay and respect they deserve.
education.short: Advocates better pay and respect for teachers and school staff.

healthcare.summary: Stelson supports lowering prescription drug prices by allowing the government to negotiate prices, banning surprise medical billing, and removing medical debt from credit reports.
healthcare.short: Supports government drug-price negotiation, banning surprise billing, medical-debt removal.

energy.summary: Stelson says she believes the scientists on climate change and supports developing renewable energy while protecting Central Pennsylvania energy-industry and fracking jobs, calling it a win-win if done right.
energy.short: Supports renewable energy while protecting fracking and energy jobs.

guns.summary: Stelson supports expanding background checks to all gun sales, red flag laws, incentives for safe firearm storage, removing untraceable ghost guns, funding community violence intervention programs, and disarming domestic abusers.
guns.short: Supports expanded background checks, red flag laws, safe storage.
